en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a broad street lined with multi‑story historic buildings and trees, dominated by a large church with a tall, narrow steeple rising above the surrounding roofs. The scene looks down Schönaugasse in an urban setting with distant hills in the background. Printed German text at the top identifies the place as Graz and mentions Schönaugasse with the St. Josef Church.
